# External research, supplied by the founder

Documents here were pasted into chat by the founder, not produced by this project. They are
kept as files so agents can READ them — a researcher run on 2026-09-09 graded a *restatement*
of the court claims rather than the artifact, because the document existed only in the
conversation and `Grep`/`Glob` were returning false negatives (trap T25).

**Treat everything in here as UNVERIFIED third-party claims.** Each was written by the person
who made the model being described. `external-research-reconciled.md` in `docs/evidence/` is
this project's own grading of the 2026-09-08 document against measurements taken here.

## Current contents: NOTHING. This folder is empty, and that is the open problem.

Audited 2026-09-10. The README above describes a practice that was never carried out — no
external document has ever been saved here. The 2026-09-08 research document that
`external-research-reconciled.md` grades **is still only in a chat transcript**, and that
evidence file opens by saying so: *"The source document is not on disk and I could not open
it... I tried eight guessed paths."*

So the cost this folder exists to prevent has already been paid once and has not been
recovered. **The fix is an action, not a doc: paste the next external document in here as a
file before anyone is asked to grade it.** Until that happens this folder is a labelled empty
shelf, which is at least honest about being empty.
